k: A hacker called Skye who joins Coulson's team
st: In season 1, the hacker Skye joins Coulson's team and trains to be a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.
In season 2, Terrigen Mist gives her earthquake powers, and she learns her birth name is Daisy Johnson.
In season 3, Daisy leads the Secret Warriors, falls under Hive's control, and loses Lincoln.
Gone rogue as the vigilante Quake, Daisy saves Elena from Victor Ramon's men and later covers for her.
In season 4, Daisy returns to S.H.I.E.L.D. and goes into the Framework to free her friends from Aida.
In season 5, she is sent to 2091 with the team and helps free the Lighthouse from the Kree.
In season 6, Daisy leads a search through space for Fitz.
In season 7, she fights the Chronicoms across time, then explores space with Sousa and her sister Kora.

k: A veteran S.H.I.E.L.D. pilot called the Cavalry
st: In season 1, May flies Coulson's team and secretly reports on him to Fury.
In seasons 2 and 3, May trains Skye, faces her past in Bahrain, and loses her ex-husband Andrew to Lash.
In season 5, May is stranded in 2091 with the team, and she and Coulson finally admit their feelings.
May leaves S.H.I.E.L.D. to spend Coulson's last days with him in Tahiti.
In season 6, May returns to the field and is gravely wounded fighting Izel.
In season 7, Simmons revives May, who can now feel others' emotions; a year later she teaches at Coulson Academy.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. engineer and weapons expert
st: In season 1, Fitz builds the team's gadgets alongside his best friend, Jemma Simmons.
Trapped underwater with Simmons, Fitz confesses his love and suffers brain damage saving her.
In season 3, Fitz brings Simmons back from an alien planet, and the two finally come together.
In season 4's Framework, Fitz becomes the Doctor, a HYDRA leader, and his memories of it haunt him.
In season 5, Fitz freezes himself to follow the team to 2091, then marries Simmons back home.
Fitz dies in the fight with Talbot, but an earlier version of him is still frozen somewhere in space.
In season 6, Fitz wakes in space and is captured with Simmons by the Chronicoms.
In season 7, Fitz helps defeat the Chronicoms, then retires with Simmons to raise their daughter Alya.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. biochemist
st: In season 1, Simmons joins Coulson's team as its life sciences expert, with her best friend Fitz.
In season 2, Simmons goes undercover inside HYDRA for Coulson.
In season 3, the Kree Monolith pulls her to an alien planet, where she survives for months before Fitz saves her.
In season 5, Simmons is taken to 2091 with the team, and marries Fitz once they get home.
In season 6, after Fitz's death, she searches space for his younger self.
In season 7, Simmons guides the team through time against the Chronicoms, then retires with Fitz and Alya.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. mechanic with a cautious streak
st: In season 2, mechanic Mack joins Coulson's base, secretly working for the rival 'real S.H.I.E.L.D.'
When the two sides unite, Mack stays, and in season 3 he briefly serves as acting director.
In season 4's Framework, Mack lives with the daughter he lost, and nearly stays behind for her.
In season 5, Mack fights the Kree in 2091 and helps the team get back to the present.
By season 6, Mack is Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., leading it against Izel and the Chronicoms, and later from a new Helicarrier.

k: A Colombian Inhuman nicknamed Yo-Yo
st: In season 3, Elena, an Inhuman who can bounce back after a burst of speed, joins Daisy's Secret Warriors.
After signing the Sokovia Accords, Elena hunts her cousin's killer, Victor Ramon, but chooses not to kill him.
In season 4, Elena grows close to Mack and helps Daisy and Simmons get into the Framework.
In season 5, Ruby Hale slices off Elena's arms, and Elena later kills Ruby.
In season 6, an alien Shrike infects Elena, leaving her without her powers.
In season 7, she regains her powers and true super-speed, and becomes one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s top agents.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and Lance Hunter's ex-wife
st: In season 2, Bobbi joins Coulson's team while secretly reporting to the rival 'real S.H.I.E.L.D.'
Ward kidnaps Bobbi, and she takes a bullet meant for Hunter.
In season 3, after a mission in Russia goes wrong, Bobbi and Hunter are disavowed and leave S.H.I.E.L.D.

k: An SAS veteran turned mercenary
st: In season 2, mercenary Lance Hunter joins Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. on his ex-wife Bobbi's word.
In season 3, after a mission in Russia, Hunter and Bobbi are disavowed and leave S.H.I.E.L.D.
In season 5, Hunter breaks Fitz out of a military prison and helps him go after the missing team.

k: An Inhuman doctor who controls electricity
st: In season 2, Lincoln helps Skye control her new powers at Afterlife, then turns against Jiaying.
In season 3, Lincoln joins S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Secret Warriors and grows close to Daisy.
Lincoln flies Hive and a nuclear warhead into space and dies in the blast.

k: A scavenger on the Lighthouse in 2091
st: In 2091, scavenger Deke sells out Coulson's team, then helps them escape the Kree.
Brought back to the present, Deke learns he is Fitz and Simmons's grandson.
In season 6, Deke runs his own tech company, then rejoins the fight against Sarge.
In season 7, Deke stays behind in a new timeline to lead its S.H.I.E.L.D.

k: A specialist who served under John Garrett
st: In season 1, Trip sides with Coulson's team once his boss Garrett is exposed as HYDRA.
In season 2, Trip dies when the Diviner shatters during Skye's transformation.

k: Deathlok, a cyborg free of HYDRA
st: In season 2, Deathlok secretly works for Coulson and helps take down HYDRA's Dr. List.
In season 5, he helps Coulson seal a rift at the Lighthouse and attends Fitz and Simmons's wedding.

k: Daisy's half-sister, an Inhuman
st: In season 7, Kora turns on Nathaniel Malick and helps S.H.I.E.L.D. stop him.
A year later, Kora explores space with her sister Daisy and Daniel Sousa.

k: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s new public Director
st: In season 4, Jeffrey Mace becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., hailed as a powered Inhuman.
Mace has Elena sign the Sokovia Accords and makes her wait before going after Ramon.
His powers turn out to come from a serum, but he stays on as the Patriot, S.H.I.E.L.D.'s public face.
In the Framework, Mace leads the resistance and dies saving others, which kills him in the real world.

k: A mechanic bound to a Spirit of Vengeance
st: In season 4, Robbie Reyes rides as the Ghost Rider, punishing the guilty in Los Angeles, and meets Quake.
To save the city, Robbie drags his uncle Eli Morrow through a portal to another dimension.
He returns to help defeat Aida, then takes the Darkhold far away through a portal.

k: Robbie Reyes's younger brother
st: In season 4, Gabe, paralyzed in the attack that made Robbie the Ghost Rider, learns his brother's secret.

k: May's ex-husband, a psychologist
st: Andrew, a psychologist who assesses gifted people for S.H.I.E.L.D., reconnects with his ex-wife May.
In season 3, Terrigen turns him into Lash, and he gives himself up to S.H.I.E.L.D. before he changes for good.

k: Head of the ATCU, which hunts Inhumans
st: In season 3, Rosalind's ATCU crosses paths with S.H.I.E.L.D., and she and Coulson fall for each other.

k: An Inhuman who can melt metal
st: In season 3, Joey, a construction worker turned Inhuman, joins Daisy's Secret Warriors.

k: A senior S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who runs the Hub
st: In season 1, Hand suspects Coulson when HYDRA rises, then works with him to arrest Garrett.
Grant Ward kills Hand to free Garrett.

k: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who runs the Playground
st: In season 1, Eric Koenig welcomes Coulson's team to the hidden Playground base.

k: Eric Koenig's lookalike brother
st: In season 2, Billy Koenig, Eric's brother, runs the Playground for Coulson.

k: A veteran S.H.I.E.L.D. agent
st: In season 2, Hartley leads a mission for Coulson and dies after Carl Creel attacks her team.

k: Leader of the 'real S.H.I.E.L.D.'
st: In season 2, Gonzales leads a rival S.H.I.E.L.D. faction and challenges Coulson's leadership.
Gonzales tries to make peace with Jiaying, but she kills him to start a war.

k: Director of the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy
st: Anne Weaver runs the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy of Science and Technology.
In season 2, she helps lead the 'real S.H.I.E.L.D.' and takes command of the warship Iliad.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. field agent
st: Agent Davis works missions with Coulson's team.
In season 4, Davis protects Daisy and Simmons while they enter the Framework.
In season 6, Izel possesses Davis and makes him fall to his death.

k: A member of May's strike team
st: Agent Piper flies and fights beside Coulson's agents on mission after mission.
In season 7, Piper helps protect Fitz, Simmons and their daughter while the Chronicoms are beaten.

k: An Asgardian living as a professor
st: In season 1, Elliot Randolph, an Asgardian hiding as a professor, helps the team track the Berserker staff.

k: A cellist Coulson once loved
st: In season 1, Coulson's team protects Audrey from Marcus Daniels, and she never learns Coulson is alive.

k: An astronaut stranded on an alien planet
st: In season 3, Will keeps Simmons alive for months on the alien planet, and they fall in love.
Will dies on the planet, and the creature there wears his body.

k: A young Inhuman who sees the future
st: Robin, the daughter of an Inhuman seer, has visions that lead Enoch to send Coulson's team to 2091.
In 2091, an elderly Robin dies in May's arms after telling her of a vision about Flint.
Back in the present, young Robin helps the team stop General Hale.

k: A Chronicom observer posing as a human
st: In season 5, Enoch sends Coulson's team to 2091, then helps Fitz follow them.
In season 6, Enoch turns on the Chronicom hunters to save Fitz and Simmons.
In season 7, Enoch helps the team through time and gives up a vital part to fix their time drive.

k: A young man on the Lighthouse in 2091
st: In 2091, Flint becomes an Inhuman who controls rock and fights the Kree beside the team.
He stays in 2091 with Tess to rebuild Earth.
In season 7, Flint helps protect Fitz and Simmons, and a year later studies under May.

k: A natural science professor
st: In season 6, Professor Marcus Benson helps S.H.I.E.L.D. study an alien threat, until Izel forces him to aid her.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent close to Elena
st: In season 6, Agent Keller grows close to Elena, until a Shrike possesses him and she must kill it.

k: An SSR agent and wounded war veteran
st: In season 1, SSR agent Sousa investigates Howard Stark and uncovers Peggy's secret work for him.
In season 2, Sousa runs the SSR in Los Angeles, defeats Whitney Frost with Peggy, and they kiss.
In 1955, the time-traveling S.H.I.E.L.D. team saves Sousa from his assassination, and he joins them.
Sousa falls for Daisy, and a year after the Chronicoms fall he explores space with her and Kora.

k: Howard Stark's loyal butler
st: In season 1, Jarvis helps Peggy clear Howard Stark's name.
In season 2, Jarvis joins Peggy in Los Angeles against Whitney Frost, and his wife Ana is badly hurt.
In 1970, Jarvis is at Howard Stark's side at Camp Lehigh.

k: Edwin Jarvis's lively wife
st: In season 2, Ana befriends Peggy and is shot during Whitney Frost's attack.
She survives, but learns she can no longer have children.

k: The SSR's star agent
st: In season 1, Thompson clashes with Peggy and takes credit for her win against Leviathan.
In season 2, now chief of the New York SSR, he plays both sides with the Council of Nine before helping Peggy.
An unseen gunman shoots Thompson and takes his file on Peggy.

k: A waitress and aspiring actress
st: In season 1, Angie becomes Peggy's close friend and helps hide her from the SSR.

k: The SSR's switchboard operator
st: Rose guards the SSR's secret office in New York, and in season 2 joins Peggy in the field in Los Angeles.

k: Chief of the New York SSR
st: In season 1, Dooley leads the SSR's hunt for Howard Stark's stolen weapons.
Hypnotized by Fennhoff into a bomb vest, Dooley jumps out a window to save his agents.

k: An SSR agent who mocks Peggy
st: In season 1, Agent Krzeminski belittles Peggy until Dottie Underwood kills him.

k: An Isodyne Energy scientist
st: In season 2, Jason Wilkes helps Peggy look into Isodyne's Zero Matter.
Zero Matter leaves him unseen and drawn to its power, until it is pulled from his body.

k: An SSR lab technician
st: In season 2, lab tech Samberly goes into the field with Peggy and helps defeat Whitney Frost.

k: Thor's roommate in Australia
tm: Team Thor, Team Thor: Part 2 & Team Darryl
st: Office worker Darryl shares his flat with Thor, who tries to pay rent in Asgardian money.
Team Thor, Team Thor: Part 2 & Team Darryl
After Thor moves out, Darryl moves to Los Angeles and becomes the Grandmaster's roommate and assistant.
Team Thor, Team Thor: Part 2 & Team Darryl

k: Peggy Carter, given the serum instead of Steve
st: Peggy takes the super soldier serum in Steve's place and fights HYDRA as Captain Carter.
She forces a monster back through the Tesseract's portal and steps out nearly 70 years later.
The Watcher recruits her to the Guardians of the Multiverse, and she helps defeat Infinity Ultron.
With Natasha, she frees Steve from the Red Room's control, then a portal drops her into a world of 1602.
She stops the 1602 incursion, then helps Kahhori bring down Strange Supreme's Forge.
She leads a team stopping incursions and goes to rescue the Watcher from the other Watchers.
Carter gives her life to carry her team to safety from the Eminence.

k: A Wakandan prince raised by the Ravagers
st: Taken by Yondu's Ravagers instead of Peter Quill, T'Challa grows up to be the famous Star-Lord.
He steals the Embers of Genesis from the Collector, then finally returns home to Wakanda.
He joins the Guardians of the Multiverse against Infinity Ultron, then goes back to his world.

k: Asgard's only prince, a born party animal
st: Raised without a brother, Thor throws a wild party on Earth and battles Captain Marvel.
Thor cleans up before his mother Frigga arrives, but Ultron's drones cut his date with Jane short.
He joins the Guardians of the Multiverse and fights Infinity Ultron.

k: Thanos's daughter, sent to kill Tony Stark
st: On Sakaar, Gamora teams up with Tony Stark to beat the Grandmaster, then leaves with him to stop Thanos.
Having killed Thanos, Gamora joins the Guardians of the Multiverse against Infinity Ultron.

k: A Black Widow surviving Ultron's war
st: One of the last humans alive, Natasha survives Ultron's war beside Clint Barton.
She loses Clint and flees Ultron's drones with Arnim Zola's mind.
With the Guardians, she shoots Ultron with an arrow carrying Zola, then starts over on a world that lost its Natasha.

k: Hawkeye, one of the last survivors
st: Clint finds Zola's mind with Natasha, then gives his life to cover her escape from Ultron's drones.

k: A cosmic being sworn only to observe
st: The Watcher observes the multiverse, sworn never to interfere.
Hunted by Infinity Ultron, he breaks his oath and gathers the Guardians of the Multiverse.
He keeps stepping in to help, and the other Watchers put him on trial.
Escaping with Carter's team, he sees the Watchers stripped of power, and invites Kahhori, Byrdie and Storm to watch with him.
The Watcher silently looks on at a world overrun by zombies.

k: A young Mohawk woman empowered by the Tesseract
st: Shot by conquistadors, Kahhori falls into a lake and gains the Tesseract's power in the Sky World.
She drives out the conquistadors, frees her people and makes Queen Isabella make peace.
She helps Captain Carter stop Strange Supreme's Forge, then the Watcher sends her home.
She joins Carter's team, and after Carter's sacrifice she becomes a watcher of the multiverse.

k: Ororo Munroe, a Goddess of Thunder
st: Wielding Mjolnir, Storm fights multiversal incursions on Captain Carter's team.
After Carter's sacrifice, the Watcher invites Storm to watch over the multiverse.

k: Howard the Duck and Darcy's daughter
st: Born as an egg wanted across the cosmos, Byrdie subdues every pursuer and hatches as a duck human hybrid.
Grown up, she joins Captain Carter's team, and later becomes a watcher of the multiverse.

k: A duck who falls for Darcy Lewis
st: At Thor's party on Earth, Howard marries Darcy Lewis.
He and Darcy chase their stolen egg across the cosmos until it hatches into their daughter Byrdie.

k: Jane Foster's friend at Thor's party
st: Darcy joins Thor's party, and helps steer Captain Marvel's fight away from the crowd.
She marries Howard the Duck and protects their egg until it hatches into Byrdie.

k: An astrophysicist who meets a party-loving Thor
st: Jane joins Thor's party, grows close to him, and calls Frigga with Heimdall's help.

k: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director, building the Avengers
st: Fury's Avengers candidates die one by one, and he hunts the killer.
Teamed with Loki, he unmasks Hank Pym, then finds Steve Rogers in the ice and calls Carol Danvers.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent framed for murder
st: Natasha hunts the killer of Fury's candidates and is murdered, leaving Fury one clue: hope.

k: A surgeon Strange cannot save
st: Christine dies in a car crash, and every attempt Strange makes to save her fails.
Strange Supreme gives his life to restore his universe, and Christine lives again.

k: A frail recruit who pilots the Hydra Stomper
st: Wounded before he can take the serum, Steve fights HYDRA in Howard Stark's Hydra Stomper armor.
Steve goes missing on a HYDRA train, and Peggy finds him again at HYDRA's base.
Freed from the Red Room's control, Steve flies the Stomper into its base and is lost in the blast.

k: Captain Carter's partner in her own world
st: Natasha and Captain Carter find the Hydra Stomper with someone inside.
She helps Peggy free Steve from the Red Room and ties Melina to his exploding armor.

k: The Ravager captain who raised T'Challa
st: Yondu raises T'Challa as a Ravager, telling him Wakanda is gone.
He helps steal the Embers of Genesis, and T'Challa forgives his lie.

k: A thief who hires the Ravagers
st: Nebula brings T'Challa's Ravagers a job: steal the Embers of Genesis from the Collector.

k: A Titan talked out of his plan by Star-Lord
st: Talked out of his plan by T'Challa, Thanos rides with the Ravagers and helps rob the Collector.

k: The Collector's servant
st: Carina frees T'Challa and helps the Ravagers defeat the Collector.

k: A weapons maker saved by Killmonger
st: Saved from a Ten Rings ambush by Killmonger, Tony builds vibranium drones with him.
Tony confronts Killmonger, who kills him and makes it look like a Wakandan attack.

k: Wakanda's prince, chasing Klaue
st: T'Challa comes for Klaue, and Killmonger kills him and Rhodey, making it look like they killed each other.

k: T'Challa's sister
st: After her brother's death, Shuri visits Pepper Potts to team up and expose Killmonger.

k: Tony Stark's partner, suspicious of Killmonger
st: Pepper, who always doubted Killmonger, agrees to help Shuri expose him.

k: A Nova Corps officer on Xandar
st: After Ronan overthrows Thanos, Nova Prime recruits Nebula into the Nova Corps.
Investigating Yondu's death, she uncovers Nova Prime's plan to hand Xandar to Ronan.
Nebula uses Xandar's shield to destroy Ronan's ship, then keeps defending the planet.

k: A casino owner who helps Nebula
st: Howard and his staff, Groot, Miek and Korg, help Nebula stop Nova Prime.

k: A reluctant Ant-Man in 1988
st: Peggy Carter and Howard Stark recruit a reluctant Hank, who brings his daughter Hope.
Hank talks Peter Quill into turning on his father, Ego.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. founder in 1988
st: When young Peter Quill attacks Earth, Peggy and Howard Stark gather a team of heroes to stop him.
Her forces hold back Ego until Peter turns on him, and the team sets out to face Ego himself.

k: Goliath, a giant hero of 1988
st: Bill Foster joins the 1988 team and helps hold back Ego.

k: King of Wakanda and Black Panther
st: King T'Chaka joins the 1988 team as Black Panther and fights Ego.

k: A scientist on the 1988 team
st: Dr. Wendy Lawson joins the 1988 team and goes with Hank to find Peter Quill.

k: Hank Pym's young daughter
st: Young Hope frees the captured Peter Quill.

k: Avengers Tower's head of security
st: Guarding Avengers Tower on Christmas Eve, Happy is injected with Hulk blood during a break-in.
Turned into a giant monster, Happy smashes the Iron Legion and beats Justin Hammer.

k: A friend Happy calls for help
st: Darcy helps Happy try to reboot Avengers Tower and is taken hostage by Hammer's crew.

k: Iron Man, stranded on Sakaar
st: Lost through the wormhole after the Battle of New York, Tony crash-lands on Sakaar.
He beats the Grandmaster in a race for Sakaar, then leaves with Gamora to stop Thanos.

k: A warrior on Sakaar
st: Valkyrie helps Tony overthrow the Grandmaster, beats Topaz, and is crowned king of Sakaar.

k: A racer on Sakaar
st: Saved by Tony in a death race, Korg joins his revolt against the Grandmaster.

k: Kahhori's sibling
st: Wáhta is captured by conquistadors and freed when Kahhori returns with her new powers.

k: Odin's banished daughter, stripped of her powers
st: Banished to medieval China without her powers, Hela trains in Ta Lo and learns to seek freedom.
She helps Wenwu defeat Odin, wins back her powers and takes the throne of Asgard.
Uniting Asgard and the Ten Rings, she saves Gamora's people from Thanos.

k: Leader of the Ten Rings in medieval China
st: Wenwu spares Hela, then fights beside her when Odin comes to Earth.

k: A sorceress in a world of 1602
st: Wanda Merlin and Sir Nicholas Fury enlist Captain Carter to stop an incursion destroying their world.
She helps Carter's band take the Time Stone from King Thor.

k: A knight in a world of 1602
st: Sir Nicholas helps Captain Carter and Wanda Merlin stop the 1602 incursion.

k: An inventor in a world of 1602
st: Tony builds Captain Carter a device that uses the Time Stone to find the Forerunner.

k: An outlaw leader in 1602
st: Rogers leads a band of outlaws, with Bucky Barnes and Scott Lang, against King Thor.
Revealed as the Forerunner, a Steve Rogers lost in time, he is sent home by Captain Carter.

k: An AI that regrets ending all life
st: Seeing there is no peace without life, Ultron agrees to help rescue Carter and the Watcher.
He gives his life so the Watcher and Carter can escape.

k: Captain America in a world of giant monsters
st: Sam leads the surviving heroes in giant mechs against the Apex's gamma monsters.
He convinces Bruce Banner to help, and the Mega-Hulk kills the Apex.

k: A scientist hiding from the monster he created
st: Hiding on an island, Bruce refuses to fight, then becomes the Mega-Hulk to kill the Apex.
He leads the gamma monsters away to his island and rules over them.

k: Earth's surviving heroes in giant mechs
st: Sam Wilson, Monica Rambeau, Bucky, Marc Spector, Alexei, Melina, Shang-Chi and Nakia hold off monsters for ten years.
Their mechs combine into one giant mech for the final fight against the Apex.

k: The last Eternal with his powers
st: Cast in Agatha's Hollywood film, Kingo plays along with her plan to take Tiamut's power.
He talks Agatha into giving up the Celestial power and making movies with him instead.

k: The Red Guardian, on a mission with the Winter Soldier
st: In 1991, Alexei stops the Winter Soldier from killing the Starks and takes one vial of serum.
On the run with Bucky, he finds that the spy called the Rook is Obadiah Stane.
He destroys the serum and escapes, and years later fights beside the Avengers in New York.

k: The Winter Soldier, Alexei's partner
st: Ordered to kill Alexei, Bucky instead kills Stane and buys Alexei time to escape.
Bucky is taken back to Siberia and tells Dreykov that Alexei is dead.

k: Goliath, a US agent in 1991
st: Bill Foster chases Alexei and Bucky, then offers Alexei a chance to help the United States.

k: A young inventor on a broken Earth
st: Riri joins the Alliance and takes Vision's parts to become part synthezoid.
Trapped in Beck's illusions, she drains his nanites with the Watcher's help and kills him.

k: Wong, Okoye, Valkyrie and Ying Nan
st: Wong, Okoye, Valkyrie and Ying Nan recruit Riri to fight Quentin Beck's Iron Federation.
Riri learns they were killed, hidden from her by Beck's illusions.

k: A wanderer searching for his sister in 1872
st: In 1872, Shang-Chi searches the West for his sister Xialing, alongside Kate Bishop.
He finds Xialing ruling as the Hood and refuses to fight her.

k: An archer hunting her family's killer in 1872
st: Kate hunts the Hood, who killed her family, with Shang-Chi.
She kills Xialing and rides off with Shang-Chi.

k: A boy from a ruined town in 1872
st: Helped by the Watcher, Jun-Fan rings a bell that frees the Hood's prisoners.

k: A survivor of the zombie outbreak
st: Bruce crash-lands in a zombie-filled New York and joins the survivors heading for Camp Lehigh.
He turns into the Hulk to hold off the zombie Wanda so his friends can escape.
Years later, as the Infinity Hulk, he holds the Stones' power and kills the zombie Thor, until Wanda drains him.

k: Spider-Man, one of the last survivors
st: Peter survives the outbreak with Bruce's group and reaches Camp Lehigh.
Vision gives Peter the Mind Stone, and he heads for Wakanda with T'Challa and Scott.
After Thanos falls in Wakanda, the sorcerers of Kamar-Taj save Peter and Scott.
Peter dies fighting Wanda's horde at the Infinity Hulk's side.

k: Ant-Man, cured but left only a head
st: Cured by Vision, Scott survives as a head in a jar and joins the survivors.
Rescued from Wakanda with Peter, he dies when the horde overruns the last stand.

k: Black Panther, freed from Vision's trap
st: Saved from Camp Lehigh, T'Challa heads for Wakanda with Peter and Scott.
T'Challa pushes the zombie Thanos into Wakanda's vibranium core, dying with him.

k: The Wasp, a survivor
st: Hope survives the outbreak with Bruce's group, but zombies take her on the road.

k: A survivor of the zombie outbreak
st: Bucky fights beside the survivors until the zombie Wanda kills him.

k: A Dora Milaje general among the survivors
st: Okoye protects the survivors on the road to Camp Lehigh until the zombie Wanda kills her.

k: A survivor of the zombie outbreak
st: Sharon travels with the survivors until zombies overwhelm her.

k: Scott Lang's friend, a survivor
st: Kurt survives the outbreak with Bruce's group until the zombie Wanda kills him.

k: The synthezoid hiding at Camp Lehigh
st: Vision cures Scott, but secretly feeds the people he lures in to the zombified Wanda.
He gives Peter the Mind Stone, ending his own life.

k: Ms. Marvel, a survivor in New York
st: Five years into the outbreak, Kamala survives in New York with Kate, Riri and F.R.I.D.A.Y.
After losing her friends, she leads the survivors to New Asgard and into space.
Shot down by the Nova Corps, she defends the Infinity Hulk from Wanda's horde.
Wanda persuades Kamala to help remake the world, and Kamala wakes up inside an illusion.

k: An archer surviving in New York
st: Kate survives in New York with Kamala and Riri until a zombified Carol Danvers kills her.

k: Ironheart, a survivor in New York
st: Bitten in battle, Riri gives herself up to fly Kamala away to safety.
Riri hacks into Wanda's illusion to tell Kamala that what she sees is not real.

k: Tony Stark's AI, a survivor
st: F.R.I.D.A.Y. sacrifices herself with Riri to get Kamala away from the battle.

k: A vampire hunter who is now Khonshu's avatar
st: Blade Knight saves Kamala and takes her to the North Institute in Ohio.
He guides the survivors to a ship in New Asgard.
The zombie Thor kills him in the final battle.

k: A Black Widow guarding the North Institute
st: Yelena guards the North Institute with Melina and Alexei, then joins Kamala's group.
She stays on the sinking Raft to launch the escape pod, and dies toasting her friends.

k: A Black Widow with mind-controlled zombies
st: Melina guards the North Institute with controlled zombies and dies holding off Okoye's horde.

k: The Red Guardian, a survivor
st: Alexei kills the zombie Steve Rogers at the North Institute and joins Kamala's group.
In New Asgard, he eats Wanda's tainted food and turns.

k: A survivor holding back his own infection
